p8_b0.ocr: In the evolving landscape of the North American automotive industry, the interplay between vehicle sales and research and development (R&D) expenditures is becoming increasingly critical. The table presented herein illustrates the vehicle sales volume by model alongside corresponding autonomous driving R&D spend, providing insights into market performance and investment strategies. For instance, ModelA achieved a sales volume of 150,000 units in 2023, reflecting a 25% increase from the previous year, while the total revenue generated from this model reached $30,000.

p8_b1.ocr: However, not all models have performed favorably; for ModelH, the sales volume decreased to 11,000 units, translating to a change of -5%. This decline raises questions about the effectiveness of current R&D strategies, particularly as expenditures on autonomous driving technology remain a focal point. Notably, the R&D spend for ModelD, which has been rebranded as ModelE, was recorded at $300K, indicating a need for strategic reassessments in the competitive landscape.
